items.text: How do patients readmitted within 30 days of hospital-at-home care, their family carers and the program's clinicians describe the events and decisions that led to the readmission, and which of those do they see as avoidable?
items.population: Patients readmitted within 30 days, their carers, and program nurses and physicians
items.outcome: Accounts of the pathway to readmission and of what could have prevented it

finer: Feasible with about 34 interviews in six months of staff time; interesting to managers deciding on expansion; novel locally; ethical with consent and care for distressed participants; relevant before beds are added.
summary: One SPIDER question focused on the pathway to readmission.
